newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo airline JAT plans 104 international flights.
newsitem.headline: Yugo airline JAT plans 104 international flights.

text.p: Yugoslav airlines JAT on Thursday released its new winter time table which includes 104 international flights per week to 40 cities on four continents, the Yugoslav news agency Tanjug said on Thursday.
"Compared to the 1995/96 winter timetable, JAT's new winter timetable includes another 17 airports in the world," JAT general manager Zika Petrovic was quoted by Tanjug as saying.

These were mainly intercontinental and Mediterranean destinations, but JAT was also planning to renew traffic with Amman, Beirut, Damascus, Cairo, Abu Dhabi, New York, Chicago, Toronto and Montreal, Petrovic said.
He said the Yugoslav carrier was still awaiting permits for some intercontinental flights, but hoped to get them soon.
